title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Dialogue Systems: Effects of User Feedback on Crowdworkers and LLMs

bias_targets.target: Assessor bias (Information source bias, Popularity bias, Personal preference bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Surveying crowdworkers to identify which information sources they relied on (e.g., personal knowledge, online search, dialogue history) and manually analyzing their written justifications to determine how these external sources introduce popularity bias and personal preference bias into their evaluations of dialogue systems.

Evaluating crowdworker annotations and qualitative justifications to observe that annotators systematically display a bias towards assigning higher ratings for 'explanation quality' to longer system responses.
